description: Standard Operating Procedure for one recipe. Steps are authored against a single BOM batch and scaled at read time. Also the Recipe Book entry: Approved, Trial and Retired versions.

fields.label: Recipe Title
fields.description: Name shown in the Recipe Book. Defaults to the item name; required when there is no Item.

fields.label: Item Code
fields.description: Leave blank for a recipe that is not an Item yet (a trial). Only recipes with an Item reach the Production Board.
Quantities in the instructions are exploded from this BOM. Leave blank to use the item's default BOM.
fields.label: BOM

fields.description: Trial and Retired recipes appear in the Recipe Book only, never on the Production Board.
fields.label: Stage
Track

fields.description: Bump this and create a new record instead of editing a procedure that has already been run.
fields.label: Version

fields.description: Only one version per item stays active; activating this one deactivates the rest. Only an Approved recipe with an Item can be active.
fields.label: Is Active

fields.description: The date the owner approved this version.
fields.label: Approved On

fields.description: Expected good output as a percentage of the BOM quantity.
fields.label: Yield %

fields.description: What changed against the previous version, one or two sentences.
fields.label: Change Summary

fields.description: What one batch makes, for a recipe with no BOM (for example 4).
fields.label: Yield Qty

fields.description: Used only when the recipe has no BOM. In an instruction, {{item:CODE|grams}} matches an ingredient's Item Code first, then its name.
fields.label: Ingredients

fields.description: Set-up time before step 1, in minutes. Not included in the scaled step total.
fields.label: Prep Time (mins)

fields.description: Equipment needed for the whole procedure, one per line.
fields.label: Equipment

fields.description: Use {{item:CODE}} in an instruction to insert the live scaled quantity. Variants: {{item:CODE|qty}}, |name, |uom.
